<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="מנחם אב_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518920054_theRebbe_925" batchId="meluket-_D7_9E_D7_A0_D7_97_D7_9D_20_D7_90_D7_91_meluket__BH_POST_1766518920054_theRebbe_925__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the Shema's declaration unites the transcendent and immanent aspects of Havayah, and that the soul's descent enables the service of teshuvah through "with all your might," fulfilling the Supernal Will.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is: "Hear O Israel, Havayah our G-d, Havayah is One,"</t>
    <t s="2">that "Havayah our G-d" is Havayah that is above the chain of descent, as our power and vitality,</t>
    <t s="3">which is the aspect of the supernal Havayah,</t>
    <t s="4">and "Havayah is One" is the lower Havayah,</t>
    <t s="5">for Havayah is the contraction and expansion, the drawing down and spreading forth,</t>
    <t s="6">through which</t>
    <t s="7">(the lower Havayah)</t>
    <t s="8">can be one,</t>
    <t s="9">meaning the coming into being of the seven firmaments and the earth and the four directions.</t>
    <t s="10">And this is: "Hear O Israel, Havayah our G-d, Havayah is One,"</t>
    <t s="11">that "Hear O Israel" is the contemplation,</t>
    <t s="12">"Havayah our G-d,"</t>
    <t s="13">the supernal Havayah as our power and vitality,</t>
    <t s="14">and through this, behold Havayah</t>
    <t s="15">(the lower one)</t>
    <t s="16">is one,</t>
    <t s="17">meaning the bittul (self-nullification).</t>
    <t s="18">And this is the matter of the soul's descent below,</t>
    <t s="19">because specifically through contemplation below, the service of teshuvah is accomplished in it,</t>
    <t s="20">which is the service of "with all your might,"</t>
    <t s="21">through which one does the will of the Place (HaMakom),</t>
    <t s="22">that is, drawing down the Supernal Will,</t>
    <t s="23">which is above even the aspect of the supernal thought,</t>
    <t s="24">the root of the souls.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the service of "with all your might" draws down the covenant, kindness, and oath from above the chain of descent, requiring a covenant to enable this drawing, and that in the era of the heels of Moshiach this service ensures the redemption.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is: "And it will be, because you will heed... and you will guard and you will do,"</t>
    <t s="2">which is the matter of the service of thought, speech, and action as it is from the aspect of the love of "with all your might,"</t>
    <t s="3">behold, through this service,</t>
    <t s="4">then "Havayah your G-d will guard for you the covenant and the kindness and the oath,"</t>
    <t s="5">for covenant, kindness, and oath are the drawings down that are above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="6">and this is the matter of "doing the will of the Place."</t>
    <t s="7">And this is what is written, "and He will guard the kindness,"</t>
    <t s="8">that the intention is in the manner of what is said in the Zohar</t>
    <t s="9">on the verse,</t>
    <t s="10">"And if a man takes his sister, it is a kindness,"</t>
    <t s="11">"a man" refers to the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="12">"who takes his sister" refers to the Congregation of Israel</t>
    <t s="13">(and this is the matter of the unification of the Holy One, blessed be He, and the Congregation of Israel,</t>
    <t s="14">the unification of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah),</t>
    <t s="15">and why is this? "It is kindness, it is certainly kindness,"</t>
    <t s="16">meaning that in order for there to be a drawing down below, this is through the kindness from Him, blessed be He.</t>
    <t s="17">And as it is written,</t>
    <t s="18">"Remember Your mercies and Your kindnesses, for they are from eternity,"</t>
    <t s="19">for the matter of remembering is only said regarding something that can be forgotten,</t>
    <t s="20">meaning that because the entirety of the chain of descent does not occupy a place before Him, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="21">therefore we ask, "Remember Your mercies and Your kindnesses,"</t>
    <t s="22">for "Your mercies" is the matter of the thirteen attributes of mercy that are above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="23">as it is written,</t>
    <t s="24">"And Havayah passed before his face and called out, Havayah,"</t>
    <t s="25">for what is written "and Havayah passed" is the supernal Havayah that is above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="26">and "Your kindnesses" is the aspect of "abundant kindness" that is above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="27">"for they are from eternity,"</t>
    <t s="28">for "olam" (world) is a term of concealment,</t>
    <t s="29">meaning that they are in concealment in their root,</t>
    <t s="30">like the matter of the concealed Sefiros,</t>
    <t s="31">the Sefiros of the bound ones,</t>
    <t s="32">and it is necessary to draw down this aspect into the world in its simple sense,</t>
    <t s="33">meaning that even below there should be the drawing down of the unlimited,</t>
    <t s="34">and through this, "strangers will stand and shepherd your flocks."</t>
    <t s="35">And this drawing down is specifically through the love of "with all your might,"</t>
    <t s="36">meaning that it is not sufficient to fulfill the Torah and mitzvos with thought, speech, and action alone,</t>
    <t s="37">for thought, speech, and action are only garments that are incomparable to the soul's faculties,</t>
    <t s="38">and certainly to the aspect of the will,</t>
    <t s="39">as is known, that thought and speech are like cause and effect,</t>
    <t s="40">that thought is the cause relative to speech,</t>
    <t s="41">and likewise speech relative to action,</t>
    <t s="42">but thought, speech, and action relative to the soul's faculties, and especially relative to the will, are incomparable,</t>
    <t s="43">therefore the service of "with all your might" is specifically necessary,</t>
    <t s="44">through which there will be a drawing down of the Supernal Will.</t>
    <t s="45">However, in order for the love of "with all your might" to effect the drawing down of the Supernal Will from above,</t>
    <t s="46">a covenant is needed for this,</t>
    <t s="47">for since the creations do not occupy any place at all,</t>
    <t s="48">how can they draw down through their service?</t>
    <t s="49">Rather, it is from the side of the covenant that the service below will draw down the revelations from above.</t>
    <t s="50">And therefore the verse precedes the covenant to kindness and oath,</t>
    <t s="51">because the entirety of the drawing down is from the side of the covenant.</t>
    <t s="52">And this is: "And it will be, because you will heed,"</t>
    <t s="53">that in the time of the heels of Moshiach, "you will surely heed,"</t>
    <t s="54">because it is the very last generation,</t>
    <t s="55">and "no outcast of His will be rejected,"</t>
    <t s="56">and therefore "you will surely heed,"</t>
    <t s="57">in the aspect of "with all your might,"</t>
    <t s="58">and through this, "He will guard the covenant,"</t>
    <t s="59">that the redemption from the exile will be with an upraised arm,</t>
    <t s="60">through Moshiach our righteousness,</t>
    <t s="61">speedily in our days.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
